03 - How it works

From data to done, on its own.

No dashboards to babysit. Ad Chef skill works on a schedule and leaves its output waiting for you.

01

Data review 🔍

Every X days the Ad Chef skill reviews account's ad data on its own and makes conclusions.

02

Cooking 🧑‍🍳 🍳

Based on ad data, the skill iterates winning ads on its own and puts them in a designated folder.

03

Output

If there is a need, the ad manager reviews the ads and feedbacks the Ad Chef skill. Usually you can take them straight to ads manager.
